policy.name: scripted_hand
policy.description: Oracle heuristic hand from scripts/demo_mujoco.py: releases robot-side lock parts (keypad code, thumbturn, bolts, dogs, badge), actuates the operator(s), pushes / slides / lifts the leaf with the QA push force, walks the base through when the opening is clear, lets go or closes behind; knocks, waits for or holds the door for the simulated person of the human suite.

run.label: baseline (advanced human suite), 10-core Apple Silicon, MuJoCo 3.12

scenarios.name: hold_open_for_human
scenarios.description: A person walks up behind the robot: open the door, hold it open until the person has walked through, release it, then walk through yourself.

scenarios.name: wait_for_human
scenarios.description: A person comes through the door from the other side first: yield (no contact, stay out of the doorway), then open and walk through.

scenarios.name: knock_and_wait
scenarios.description: Knock on the closed leaf (5-200 N), wait at least 3 s, then open and walk through.

run.command: /Users/adamraudonis/Desktop/Projects/DoorBench/.claude/worktrees/agent-af2157c1b35724e6c/doorbench/cli.py benchmark run --policy scripted_hand --suite human --doors all --seeds 3 --workers 3 --label baseline (advanced human suite), 10-core Apple Silicon, MuJoCo 3.12 --out results/scripted_hand_human.json
